column4: Total liabilities (including minority interest before 2001): RCFD2948 as filed from 1984Q1. Before 1984, liabilities net of subordinated debt (RCFD2950) + subordinated debt (RCFD3200): exact, 2948 = 2950 + 3200 for 100% of banks in every 1984 quarter where both are filed. For banks with foreign offices the FFIEC 014 did not collect consolidated subordinated debt in 1976-1983, so their total liabilities is total assets minus equity (RCFD2170 - RCFD3210), both collected from them throughout: on the FFIEC 031, 2948 = 2170 - 3210 for 98-100% of foreign-office banks 1984-2000. On the FR Y-9C (from 1986) the filed total BHCK2948; the pre-1984 Call Report fallback does not apply.

Total liabilities net of subordinated notes and debentures: RCFD2950 as filed to 2010; liabilities - subdebt after (identical 1985-2010). Y-9C: total liabilities (BHCK2948) less subordinated notes and debentures (BHCK4062, which on the Y-9C includes limited-life preferred).

Total loans and leases gross of unearned income: RCFD1400 as filed to 2010; ll_tot (RCFD2122) + unearned income (RCFD2123) after (identical 1985-2010). Y-9C: loans net of unearned income (BHCK2122) + unearned income (BHCK2123); no gross line is filed.

Loans to individuals for household, family and other personal expenditures (consumer loans): RCFD1975 as filed to 2010; credit cards and revolving plans plus other consumer loans after (identical from 1990).

Total operating income: RIAD4000 as filed to 2010; total interest income + total noninterest income after (identical 1985-2010). Y-9C: total interest income (BHCK4107) + total noninterest income (BHCK4079).

Total operating expense (excludes the loan-loss provision from 1985): RIAD4130 as filed to 2010; total interest expense + total noninterest expense after (identical 1985-2010). Y-9C: total interest expense (BHCK4073) + total noninterest expense (BHCK4093).

Investment securities, excluding trading: total investment securities (RCFD0390) to 1993; held-to-maturity at amortized cost (1754) + available-for-sale at fair value (1773) from 1994, plus equity securities with readily determinable fair value (JA22) from 2018 when they left AFS. The 1994 break is indistinguishable from an ordinary quarter.

Total deposits, consolidated: domestic offices (RCON2200) plus foreign offices (RCFN2200). Equals the reported RCFD2200 exactly before 2011; after 2011 RCFD2200 is not consolidated in the source files (see the header of core_series.csv). Y-9C: no total-deposits line; domestic noninterest-bearing (BHDM6631) + interest-bearing (BHDM6636) + foreign offices (foreign_dep).

Total interest expense on deposits: RIAD4170 as filed to 2010; after, foreign-office interest (RIAD4172) + domestic transaction (4508) + savings (0093) + time deposits (A517+A518 to 2016, HK03+HK04 from 2017), identical to the reported total 1987-2010. Y-9C: foreign offices (BHCK4172) + other domestic deposits (BHCK6761; BHCK4176 in 1986-89) + domestic time deposits (BHCK4174 to 1996, A517+A518 1997-2016, HK03+HK04 from 2017). No reported total exists on the Y-9C; checked by the continuity of the implied deposit rate across the 1997 and 2017 changes.
